verdict.rejection_reason: Candidate shows different character: long light hair, no glasses, no hooded jacket with lightning patch, contradicting all three required attributes.

decision_rationale: Empirical evidence proves that reference-anchored generation via POST /v1/images/edits preserves character identity across diverse scenes (6/6 pass, 100%), whereas unanchored text-to-image experiences severe attribute drift (0/6 pass, 0%). Furthermore, Muse Spark demonstrates high-accuracy discrimination (accepted matching candidate, rejected corrupted candidate with 100% attribute accuracy), and SAM 3.1 reliably provides promptable concept bounding boxes and masks.
